_meta.primary_source: AISC Shapes Database v15.0 (November 2017), workbook sheet "Database v15.0"
_meta.source_note: Official aisc.org download returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch; the identical AISC v15.0 workbook was obtained from a public GitHub copy (MIT-licensed repo packaging, AISC data and disclaimer unchanged).
_meta.units: SI (mm, mm^2, mm^3, mm^4, mm^6, kg/m)
_meta.props_convention: Zx_mm3/Zy_mm3 = ELASTIC section modulus (AISC Sx/Sy); Sx_mm3/Sy_mm3 = PLASTIC section modulus (AISC Zx/Zy). Matches AU record convention.
_meta.hss_notes: RHS/SHS: d=overall depth H, b=overall width B, t_des=0.93*t_nom design wall (ERW A500), r_outside = 2*t_des and r_inside = t_des (the radii AISC tabulated properties are based on: published area matches the closed form with these radii within 0.4% for all 388 shapes; also stated in Steel Tube Institute / Structure magazine articles), h_flat/b_flat = AISC flat widths (B-3*t_des). mass_per_m_kg is AISC nominal weight (based on t_nom), area is based on t_des so mass vs area*7850 differs by ~7% by AISC convention.
